mkdir -p /app/output && cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Controller for the room instance. Keep this file as the episode record."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
layout = spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
names = [x if isinstance(x, str) else x.get('name', str(x)) for x in layout]

def save_view(result, stem):
    for camera, frame in result.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'{stem}_{camera}.png')
    (OUT / f'{stem}_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2, default=str))

def send(actions, stem, cameras=['room_camera'], video='none'):
    result = r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(actions, dtype=np.float32), dt=0.02,
                      interpolate='linear', cameras=cameras, video=video, note=stem)
    save_view(result, stem)
    print(stem, result.meta['control_steps'], result.meta['done'], result.meta['reason'], flush=True)
    return result

if __name__ == '__main__':
    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2, default=str))
    result = r.get_obs()
    save_view(result, 'initial')
    print('status', r.status(), flush=True)
    print('cameras', list(result.last), flush=True)
    print('actuators', len(names), names, flush=True)
PY
